name: Girls' Frontline: The Lunasia Covenant
storyline: Time rolls on, the world changes again. A behemoth crosses the world, a mysterious nation appears in the void, its legendary inhabitant conjures a new power, and the blue butterfly observes from Nirvana. “Facts”, “Fiction”, from the cracks in “...”, new seeds grow forlornly. The brave edge of a new world writes prose in bullets, just like back then—
summary: A science-fiction cooperative third-person shooter set in the Girls' Frontline universe, featuring playable Dolls from Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium.
